# Unified LLM Provider Interface

The file implements a unified interface for various Large Language Model (LLM) providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, AzureOpenAI, Cloudflare) using the method 'complete'. This standardizes how prompts are sent to LLMs and structured outputs are returned, simplifying integration and interchangeability of providers.
